notes: Both תְּבֹרַךְ units keep their auxiliaries and subject pronouns, the first discontinuous around the subject name (rules 17, 25).
The article on הַקֵּינִי takes the second written *the*, while the construct אֵשֶׁת takes a supplied one, its rectum being an anarthrous name (rules 15, 29).
Both marginal *Or, of* notes on the comparative prepositions read and set aside (rule 38).
